recognize_zh: p53 免疫染色中，大多數中型腫瘤細胞核呈強而一致的棕色染色，只有少數細胞為藍色陰性，這種高比例強陽性（overexpression）提示被套細胞淋巴瘤帶有 TP53 突變的高風險表型。
features: Strong, diffuse nuclear p53 staining in the majority (well over 50%) of tumor cells
Intermediate-sized cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Only a minority of hematoxylin-counterstained negative nuclei
Staining intensity strong and relatively uniform, unlike the weak heterogeneous wild-type pattern
Dense sheet-like growth without intervening architecture
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for p53 shows strong nuclear expression in the majority of neoplastic cells, far exceeding the scattered weak staining seen with a wild-type pattern. The positive cells are intermediate in size and grow in dense sheets. This overexpression pattern is associated with TP53 mutation, which in mantle cell lymphoma correlates with blastoid/pleomorphic morphology and poor response to standard chemoimmunotherapy; correlation with TP53 sequencing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Wild-type p53 shows scattered nuclei of variable, mostly weak intensity rather than strong uniform staining in most tumor cells.
A null pattern shows complete absence of nuclear staining with preserved internal control, the opposite of the diffuse overexpression here.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with TP53 mutation
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and are cyclin D1- and SOX11-, whereas blastoid MCL retains cyclin D1 and CD5 expression.
